text: Hello everyone, welcome back to our English class.Since we have finished learning unit 2, let's have a revision.In today's lesson, we will still talk about traditional Chinese skills.We are going to review the words and the phrases and the passive voice.At the same time, we will describe an artist, identify objects through listening and ask questions in an interview.Finally, we will show our opinions on some traditional skills.What have we learned in unit 2?We read a passage about comment fishing.We talked about how to use the passive voice.We learned how to describe people in a certain setting, and how to ask questions in an interview.Also, we wrote an article about a traditional skill and read an introduction to tea.In these lessons, we learned about several traditional Chinese skills, like comment fishing, paper cutting, and clay sculpting.And our friend Jenny is always with us.She has done a lot on this topic.She is very busy these days.What is she busy with?Complete these sentences with the words and phrases in the box, and then you will get the answer.One minute to finish task one on the worksheet.Let's check the answers.Number one.The school newspaper removed the old sections and started a new column on traditional Chinese skills.Number two.The new column is so popular that the newspaper has got up to 100 readers on campus.Number three.Jenny has done a lot of research these days, so that she is familiar with Chinese culture.Number four.She is sorry to hear that some of the skills are only known by the elderly people, because few young people are willing to learn them.Number five.Sometimes Jenny has to control the camera and the recorder by herself when interviewing the artists.And number six.She set off early to interview a great artist this morning.Did you have all your answers right?I believe you did a good job.As you can see,Jenny is really busy.Number six.She is sad to hear that some of the skills are only known by the elderly people, because few young people are willing to learn them.Number seven.She is going to interview an artist.And this is a picture of the artist.Who is he?Wong.What does he look like?Please describe Mr.Wong according to the picture.One minute for you to speak out.Same on the face.我认识的一位学生是这样的。Wong是一个年轻男孩,他长得圆滑的,他长得短短的,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,他脖子小,Well, Jenny didn't tell me, but I know what the man uses for his job.I will describe two objects.While listening, please write down some key information in Task 2 on the worksheet, and then choose the right picture.The first thing, it gives out light.And it needs electricity to keep working.What did you write on the worksheet?Give out light.Need electricity.Which one do you choose?The electric light.It's hard for us to guess Mr.Wong's job now.Let's move on to the next thing.Again, listen for some key information.It is in a bright color and in the shape of an animal.It is made of hard leather.It has movable legs.In a bright color and in the shape of an animal.Made of hard leather.And movable legs.Look at pictures.Picture B.It is a Chinese puppet.So what is Mr.Actually, he is an artist who performs shadow plays.What are shadow plays?Take out your worksheet.There is an introduction to them in task 3.Please complete it with verbs in their proper forms.现在,让我们检查答题。他们是被介绍被收集被成立被反映被表演被过去这些词全是在过去的形态中。你答对了吗?现在我们知道,陰影是一个传统的中国技巧。珍妮将会面试陈王,是陰影演员。当我们谈论如何思考要问的问题,和准备答题,让我们检查珍妮的答题是否够正确和专业。她将会问小狗,陰影,还有,陈王对他的作品的观点。她已经准备了一些问题。这些问题好吗?也许不是。第一个问题是关于小狗,第二个问题是关于陈王的作品,第三个问题是关于小狗。我们对答题的评论感到困惑。请帮助她把问题放在正确的位置。去考虑小狗,她应该问小狗是什么样的在第一个位置,第二个问题是我们如何继续装成小狗。去谈谈陰影的位置,珍妮应该问你如何装扮陰影的位置。陈王对他的作品的观点是如何?為什麼你會在這職業上?然後,你對這傳統技術的未來有什麼想法?謝謝你的幫助。珍妮知道她應該問的什麼問題,但所有這些問題都是WH問題。如果她這樣問的話,這次的面試不會太自然或太偏僻。珍妮應該要多問一些對與錯的問題、標題的問題,以及隱藏的問題。例如,現在是你的機會。請問一些更自然、更偏僻的方式。請問你的工作如何?珍妮向我們提供了我們的建議,並重複了她的問題。你能告訴我狗狗的樣子嗎?做狗狗很困難,對嗎?我正在思考你如何表演陰影。我可以知道為什麼你會在這職業上?你對這個傳統技術的未來有什麼想法?你對這些問題有什麼想法?她問了不同類型的問題。我相信她的面試一定會成功。珍妮很忙碌,不僅是因為她有幾位藝術家來面試,也因為新聞開始了一個新的項目,他們將會在未來消失。許多學生寫了一些文章為了展示他們的經典中國技術的觀點。這裡寫了一篇文章關於陰影的演出。請閱讀這篇文章,並回答問題。為何作者認為陰影的未來有什麼想法?這就是你的工作圖第四項目。因為這篇文章關於陰影的未來有什麼想法?他认为,陰影会在未来消失,这是他的观点。为什么他认为如此?有两个原因。他用了翻译词,以外,以令他的文章更有道理和容易理解。您可以看到,他在一个非常安排的方式展示了他的观点和原因。现在,您将写出一篇文章,在Task 5的工作室上完成了。Times up!What do you think of the future of comment phishing?Some students think that comment phishing will disappear in the future.What makes them think so?First, because of some new methods for phishing.Second, a poor salary may be one of the reasons.And I believe you have some other reasons.On the other hand, some students don't agree.They think comment phishing won't disappear in the future.Because it is a traditional Chinese skill.Any other reasons?Because there are some effective measures that are taken to keep the skill alive.I believe you have some good reasons to support your opinion.And don't forget to use the transition words like besides or in addition to make your article clear and well organized.Since time is limited, let's read my student Betty's work first.Then you can finish your writing after class.In my opinion, comment phishing won't disappear in the future.Comment phishing is a traditional Chinese skill.It shows the wisdom of ancient Chinese people and the friendly relations between men and nature.That's why it should be well protected.In fact, the government has done a lot of things to keep the traditional Chinese skill alive.Different projects have been made to call on people's attention.Besides, the skill is also written into students' textbooks to encourage more young people to be interested in it.As you can see, it won't disappear in the future.We can find her opinion and two reasons.Any transition words?Yes, besides.Betty did a good job, and I hope you will also do it well.In this unit, we learned about some traditional Chinese skills and their current situations.I hope we can play a part in introducing them to the whole world and helping keep them alive.That's all for today.Here is today's homework.Goodbye.
